extraction.Name: James Wilde
extraction.Refused/Protested: refused to take the patent for some time, but that he was told by the District Farmer and the Superintendent that if he did not take the patent and pay the taxes that he would lose the land and on their advise he took it and signed the receipt
extraction.Recorded patent: he had the patent recorded shortly after he receipted for it
extraction.Buyer: State Bank of Interior mortgaged for $2000.00; he then made a State Loan to pay this mortgage, and in April, 1927, they foreclosed on the land and took his place
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: mortgaged his land to State Bank of Interior for $2000.00 to pay taxes on it and his personal taxes that had been charged against the land
extraction.Occupation/Income: rents a place to farm, but has very little equipment and is unable to do much
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health of deponent and wife is poor; has an invalid wife and two grandchildren (orphans) to support; has no land, no home and nothing; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since patent was issued; deponent's sight is very poor; document sworn November 13, 1928, County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Pine Ridge Agency (Shannon County, South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
